dailyTips.title: Stay hydrated
dailyTips.body: Drink enough water to help maintain hydration during pregnancy.

dailyTips.title: Rest well
dailyTips.body: Choose a comfortable resting position and follow clinician guidance.

dailyTips.title: Balanced nutrition
dailyTips.body: Meet daily nutrition needs and discuss supplements with a midwife or doctor.

dailyTips.title: Light routine movement
dailyTips.body: Light activity may support circulation when appropriate for your pregnancy condition.

dailyTips.title: Notice fetal movement
dailyTips.body: If you feel movement patterns change, contact a healthcare professional for guidance.

dailyTips.title: Manage stress
dailyTips.body: Gentle breathing and family support can help daily comfort.

dailyTips.title: Keep ANC visits
dailyTips.body: Continue antenatal care according to your healthcare facility schedule.

monitoring.hardwareReadyDesc: This panel is ready to receive FETAL-GUARD belt data. When the hardware is active, Piezo, FSR, and MAX30102 channels can feed this display without changing the user flow.
monitoring.deviceNotConnectedDesc: A device is registered for this account. Scan and connect the belt before starting signal reading.
monitoring.deviceNotRegisteredTitle: No device for this account yet
monitoring.deviceNotRegisteredDesc: Ask an admin or clinician to assign a FETAL-GUARD belt first so sessions use the correct device data.
monitoring.waitingDeviceDataDesc: Reading status is available after the belt UID matches the registered device and current sensor data is received.
monitoring.sessionReadyDesc: Start after the device UID matches the account registration and current data is received.
monitoring.readingStatusDescription: This status is based on the latest connection and display reference ranges, not a medical assessment or AI analysis.

monitoring.persistenceOffline: Offline; the session remains open and data has not been sent

monitoring.persistenceQueueFull: The data queue is full; the session needs review

monitoring.errorMissingSampleRate: The device has not provided information required to store data. Reconnect the device.
monitoring.errorQueueFull: The data queue is full. Stop the session and check the connection before continuing.
monitoring.errorDeviceNotVerified: Wait until the device UID matches the account registration and current data is received.
monitoring.errorSessionDeviceConflict: The active session is bound to another device. Close that session before continuing.
monitoring.errorUnsavedPackets: Some data has not been stored. Reconnect to the internet and try stopping again.
monitoring.hybridSubtitle: A summary of current data and display reference ranges; not a medical assessment or AI analysis.
monitoring.screeningOnly: Early screening, not a medical assessment
monitoring.modelFusionDesc: The display uses data actually received from Piezo, FSR, and MAX30102 channels without creating substitute values.
monitoring.temporalPatternDesc: Events will appear after validated system processing produces them from session data.
monitoring.recommendedStable: Continue monitoring as scheduled and keep routine checkups.
monitoring.recommendedRepeat: Adjust belt placement or repeat the session if data quality is not stable.
monitoring.recommendedConsult: Contact a healthcare professional or facility for further guidance.
monitoring.technicalDetailsDesc: Optional: sensor charts and channels. You do not need to interpret them yourself.
monitoring.maternalVitalsSubtitle: MAX30102 data and FHR estimates are arranged for readability without changing clinical reference limits.
monitoring.waveformHint: Charts show data available during the session and are not a clinical assessment result.
monitoring.eventLegend: Events are shown only after validated system processing provides them.

history.pdfSubtitle: Early Fetal Health Monitoring System - PKM-KC
history.pdfImportant: IMPORTANT - Read before using this report:
history.pdfDisclaimer1: Data in this report comes from the device and has not been reviewed by a clinician unless stated otherwise.
history.pdfDisclaimer2: This early screening report DOES NOT replace an assessment. The * mark is a pressure-sensor indication, not a clinical assessment.
history.pdfDisclaimer3: FHR reference range: 110-160 bpm. FETAL-GUARD is a self-monitoring aid, not a replacement for CTG/USG/Doppler.

settings.faqReplaceDesc: No. FETAL-GUARD is an early screening tool and does not replace CTG, Doppler, ultrasound, doctors, midwives, or healthcare facilities.
